items.headline: Tonbo Imaging India shares up 17%, jumps 90% from IPO price band | Buy, sell or hold?
items.original: Tonbo Imaging India shares surged over 17% on 26 October, extending gains to about 90% above the IPO price after listing at premiums exceeding 65%. The ₹852.18-crore IPO was subscribed 135.90 times. Analysts suggested that allotted investors consider partial profit-booking or holding long-term.
